title: Hosted endpoint PRD cookbook and launch checklist
creator: Asha Iyer
description: This ticket delivers a single, copyable PRD "cookbook" and a prescriptive launch checklist for the hosted inference endpoint family (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank). The goal is to provide a repeatable, minimal-risk runbook for PMs, Eng, Design and SRE to land new endpoint variants with consistent behavioral contracts, telemetry, and rollback criteria. The artifact is intentionally pragmatic: a concise conformance matrix, example request/response schemas, gating SLOs, a QA matrix mapped to test artifacts, and a step-by-step cutover and post-launch monitoring checklist.
scope: Includes: behavioral contracts and acceptance criteria for chat, completion, embedding and rerank surfaces
Includes: canary and staged rollout plan with quantitative gating rules and telemetry dashboards
Includes: SDK compatibility checklist and migration notes for breaking changes
Includes: billing/token attribution and rate-limit policy for new endpoints
Excludes: Dedicated capacity work, private/VPC packaging, and non-hosted infra changes
acceptance_criteria: API contract: example request/response JSON for chat, completion, embedding and rerank committed to API spec repo
Behavioral conformance: 90% of evaluated prompt-set responses must meet quality baseline (evaluation harness) before canary
Performance SLOs: p95 latency <= 220ms for embeddings (single-vector), p95 <= 350ms for short-chat (<=128 tokens), token throughput validated at 2x expected load
Reliability: error rate <= 0.5% during 24h baseline test and degradations are classified and mapped to fallback policies
Observability: dashboards and alerting (latency SLO, error-rate, token-cost regression) are provisioned and verified by SRE
Rollout gating: automated rollback triggers implemented for SLO breaches and quality regressions
SDK compatibility: official JS and Python SDKs pass conformance shim tests and client-side streaming behaviors verified
Billing: per-token accounting validated end-to-end in staging and invoices show correct attribution
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Dry run: internal-only endpoint toggled in staging, run synthetic traffic at 1x, validate metrics for 48h
Phase 1 - Canary: 1% production traffic for 2h, expand to 5% for 6h if no SLO regressions
Phase 2 - Gradual: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 48h with automated quality checks between jumps
Phase 3 - Full: 100% after 72h of progressive load with no critical alerts
Rollback: immediate rollback to previous model/variant if any gating rule trips; targeted rollback guidance included per customer lane
Fallback: default route to compatibility model (quantized or lower-capacity variant) if capacity constrained
telemetry_and_metrics: Per-route latency histogram with p50/p95/p99 buckets and token-normalized latency
Per-customer token consumption and cost-per-token trend line
Quality signal: eval-run pass-rate on daily prompt-slice (regression detection)
Error taxonomy: client-error (4xx), infra-error (5xx), model-timeout, decode-error
Rollout gates: quality-pass-rate, infra-error-rate, latency-p95 threshold
Tracing: end-to-end request traces with KV-cache hit/miss tags and batching size metadata
performance_slos: Embeddings: p95 latency <= 220ms for single-vector, error-rate < 0.2%
Short-chat (<=128 tokens): p95 <= 350ms, throughput validated at expected QPS
Long generation (>512 tokens): tail latency guidance documented and fallback allowed to chunked streaming
Availability: 99.9% uptime for hosted API surface (monitoring coverage required)
api_contract_changes: Additions: structured 'metadata' field in response for model.variant, quantization_profile and routing_id
Streaming: explicit 'streaming_chunk' envelope introduced for chat streaming backwards-compatible with current SDKs
Deprecation: legacy 'embeddings.v1/simple' path will be deprecated; migration notes included
Schema examples committed to docs repo with JSON Schema and openapi snippets
qa_and_test_plan: Unit: API input validation and schema conformance tests (JS/Python) must be green
Integration: end-to-end flow in staging including billing attribution and SDK examples
Load: run k6 scenario at expected peak QPS * 1.5 for 2 hours and validate SLOs
Chaos: network partitions and simulated GPU OOMs run in staging to verify fallback behavior
Eval: automated human-in-the-loop eval set (200 prompts per surface) must pass quality gate
Security: SSO and KMS access paths exercised and audit logs validated

notes: Cookbook style: each endpoint entry must include sample prompts, edge-case failure modes, and an 'When to use' guidance for customers
Keep the conformance matrix minimal: only behavioral checks that are automatically verifiable should gate rollout
We will pilot this cookbook with two internal integrators (search and assistants) before public launch
